scope: Hand-authored synthetic factual-support labels, not legal compliance judgments or representative production accuracy. Each case has one obligation. A compatible excerpt supports all stated conditions; partial, ambiguous or irrelevant evidence is insufficient. Explicit incompatible facts are contradicted. No live LLM is used by the baseline adapter.
